name: Poisoned Glen

attributes.attribute: his evil eye split the rocks of the poison valley
made by Lugh's killing of Balor
still dangerous near Dunlewey in Donegal

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Poisoned Glen is an Irish site. Lugh, the hero, slew Balor. Balor was a monstrous king of the Fomorians. The dying king's evil eye split the rock of a small valley. The place stays dangerous to this day. It lies near the town of Dunlewey in County Donegal, in the north of Ireland.

okr.objective: Describe the Poisoned Glen and how Balor's evil eye formed it.
key_results: Say Balor's evil eye split the rocks when Lugh killed him.
Place the glen near Dunlewey in County Donegal.
Note that it is still a dangerous a site to this day.
